tracks.name: hol
tracks.description: Prove in HOL4 that submitted RISC-V bytes satisfy the fixed init-e Certificate for the Pancake EVM guest within a step bound K, as an OpenTheory article, and minimize K. The initial submission claims infinity.
tracks.hardware: Official runs: blacksmith-32vcpu-ubuntu-2404 (128 GB RAM), directly on the runner; the verifier never executes candidate ML. Replay limits: 21,600 s CPU and wall time, 112 GiB address space. The 2.8 GB baseline article took 8,973 s and 90.4 GiB RSS upstream. Cold setup builds Poly/ML, HOL4 and the CakeML compiler theories; its duration is not yet measured (23-hour job timeout).
